name: Sertifier Certificate & Badge Maker for WordPress – Tutor LMS
author: sertifier

sections.description:
Seamless Integrations

Our plugin connects effortlessly with the tools you already use, including learning management systems, webinar services, and automation platforms like Zoom, Moodle, Canvas, Tutor LMS, Zapier, and more. Simplify your workflow and focus on what really matters: teaching and engagement.

Key Features

Instant Certificate Templates

Choose from a variety of professionally designed templates—no design experience needed. Add your logo, color schemes, and brand elements with a few clicks.

One-Click Badge & Certificate Issuing

Say goodbye to manual emails. Automatically send personalized credentials to learners immediately after they finish a lesson or course.

Social Media Sharing

Help students share their newly earned certificates on LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook with a single button, boosting your brand visibility.

Real-Time Analytics

Track opens, shares, and clicks to see how learners are interacting with their certificates. Use these insights to improve course content and marketing efforts.

Flexible Customization

Add personalized fields—like course titles and learner names—to every certificate. Edit text, colors, and design elements to match your style.

White-Label Option

Remove external branding so that your certificates and badges reflect only your organization.

Advanced Integrations

Automate tasks through Zapier and other third-party services, syncing your learners’ progress across multiple platforms.

Why Choose Sertifier’s Certificate & Badge Maker for WordPress?

  • Easy Setup & Use: Install, customize, and start issuing badges and certificates in minutes.
  • Engaging for Students: Motivate learners to complete courses and proudly share their achievements online.
  • Powerful Marketing: Every shared certificate serves as free advertising, attracting new signups through social proof.
  • Comprehensive Analytics: Gain actionable insights into learner engagement and course effectiveness.
  • Highly Compatible: Works smoothly with various WordPress themes and popular LMS tools.

Get Started Today

Empower your learners, strengthen your brand, and turn achievements into social proof. Install Certificate & Badge Maker for WordPress and start issuing professional, fully customizable credentials—without the hassle.
